originalSourceText:
Q.5   Which statement correctly distinguishes repeatability from accuracy?

      (A) Repeatability refers to reaching mathematically defined points.

      (B) Accuracy refers to returning to a previously taught point.

      (C) Repeatability  is returning to a taught point, while accuracy  is reaching a
       mathematically defined point.

      (D) Both terms have identical meanings.

       Explanation: (C) Refer Slide 11 of Lecture Manipulator Mechanism Design-I

       Repeatability measures how consistently a robot returns to a taught position, whereas
      accuracy measures closeness to a mathematically specified position.
